messages:
Maya (People Ops): Heads up — final round for candidate J on Tue 11am PT. Need a scribe + rubric check. Quick confirm: who can scribe and who will own the debrief?
Alex (Eng): I can scribe if no objections. What rubric weights should we use? Last round felt heavy on design (60/40).
Priya (Hiring Lead): Let's standardize to 50/30/20 for this role: system design 50, coding 30, collaboration 20. @Sam can you confirm timing with candidate's timezone? Candidate is in CET.
Sam (SWE): Confirmed — 11am PT = 20:00 CET for them. 50/30/20 works. I'll own the debrief. @Maya please add transcript/recording consent to the invite.
Ben (Interview Ops): Added calendar invite + Zoom. Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.com/j/123456789. Scribe — please enable recording and captions. :thumbsup:
Maya (People Ops): Quick checklist before we go live:
• Scribe: timestamp questions + per-question bullets
• Capture rubric anchor notes inline
• Submit final scores to the score sheet: https://docs.redwood.com/hiring/scores
Also run the pre-load command in the meeting if you want: ```/load_rubric 50 30 20```
scribe-bot: Reminder: enable recording 5m before start. Consent blurb: "We record interviews for calibration. If you object, inform us now."
Priya (Hiring Lead): Any objections to recording? Candidate was fine earlier — no objections from me.
Alex (Eng): No objections. I'll scribe. @Maya could you add me as scribe on the calendar invite and give access to the doc?
Maya (People Ops): Done — Alex added as scribe, Sam set as debrief owner. Created post-interview doc with the template and pinned it to the event.
Sam (SWE): One more ask: keep system design to 25m, coding to 30m, collaboration/behavioral to 15m. Can we enforce strict timers?
Maya (People Ops): Noted — I'll add 5m buffers and a hard timer note in the invite. Thanks all :pray:
